tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: Lists the published collections (lookbooks and shop edits) on this brand site. Returns the slug, name, description and page URL of each.

tools.name: list_featured_collections
tools.description: Lists the collections this brand features on its home page, in page order. Returns the slug, name, description and page URL of each.

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Gets one collection by slug with its styles, 48 per page. Each style has an id, name, colours, photo URLs and its page URL; on a shop, also its price in USD and availability. Returns not found for a slug this site does not publish.

tools.name: get_style
tools.description: Gets one style by id: name, description, colours, materials, categories, photo URLs and page URL, and on a shop its price in USD, availability and sizes. Returns not found for a style this site does not publish.

tools.name: submit_inquiry
tools.description: Sends one message to this brand's team on the user's behalf: a question, a wholesale or stockist inquiry, or a request about a style. Use it only when the user has asked to contact the brand and has given the name and email to reply to. Returns whether it was sent; the team replies by email, and not

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_collections, list_featured_collections, get_collection, get_style · Private data: submit_inquiry · Public sink: get_collection, get_style, submit_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_collections, list_featured_collections, get_collection, get_style · Private data: submit_inquiry · Public sink: get_collection, get_style, submit_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
